maternity.baby_day_one_cover: New Born Baby covered from day one within family floater Sum Insured applicable to the Employee.
maternity.notes: Maternity Expenses Benefit is available for Employees or Spouse Only if covered in data. Maternity claim is payable for first two dependent children only. Pre & Post natal expenses are not covered.

waiting_periods.initial_30_day: Waived off for existing members and new joinees.
waiting_periods.first_year: Waived off for all Insured Members.
waiting_periods.second_year: Waived off for all Insured Members.
waiting_periods.pre_existing_disease: Covered for existing members and new joinees.

other_benefits.day_care: Covered as per List of Day Care procedure attached under Annexure A

other_benefits.bariatric_treatment: Bariatric Surgery covered under the policy as per terms and conditions upto 50% of the Sum Insured
other_benefits.psychiatric_treatment: Covered under the policy as per terms and conditions upto 50% of the Sum Insured

infertility_surrogacy: Excluded (Infertility & related ailments including male sterility are outside the scope of this policy)
ambulance: Payable up to a maximum amount of Rs. 1,000/- per claim
